briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google DeepMind push frontier boundaries as AGI competition intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has accelerated with multiple frontier model releases this month. Investment remains robust while safety concerns grow around deployment scale.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview while Anthropic launched Claude 4. xAI deployed Grok-3 and DeepSeek unveiled R2 with strong benchmark gains.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments; Microsoft and Google expanded data center capacity in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory frameworks slow frontier model deployment before 2027?
